metadata.name: MasterCardPushProvisioning
metadata.description: Use this API to generate encrypted payload for Push provisioning of a Mastercard Card details in the Payment APP(Google pay, Apple pay etc.).

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition : At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition : At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountExpiry
request_fields.description: Expiration Date of the Card. Valid Values: 0-9 DateFormat : MMYY Example : 0925 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: WalletApplication
request_fields.description: Type of Wallet Valid Values: 01=Google 02=Samsung 03=Apple Example:01 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: TavVersionNumber
request_fields.description: Token Authentication Value Format Valid Value : 3 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: DataValidUntilTimestamp
request_fields.description: ISO 8601 format of the date and time (with Time Zone) the TAV expires and will no longer be honored Allowable Values: 29

request_fields.name: FinancialAccountInformation
request_fields.description: Financial account being tokenized Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: TokenUniqueReference
request_fields.description: Token Unique Reference associated with the token. Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: PANUniqueReference
request_fields.description: PAN Unique Reference associated with the token. Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: CardholderName
request_fields.description: Full Name of Cardholder. Format: lastname/firstname or firstname lastname. Example: Jacob B Jonas Allowable Values: 27

request_fields.name: BillingAddress
request_fields.description: BillingAddress

request_fields.name: Line1
request_fields.description: Address Line 1 for billing address Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 Meca Way Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: Line2
request_fields.description: Address Line 2 for billing address Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example:15 Penang Street Point Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: City
request_fields.description: City for billing  address Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CountrySubdivision
request_fields.description: Country subdivision of billing address Allowable Values: 12

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder Postal Code of billing address Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: Country
request_fields.description: Country of billing address . Valid values :Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: USA Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: Nonce
request_fields.description: This tag should containg the nonce value received from Apple wallet Allowable Values: 4000

request_fields.name: NonceSignature
request_fields.description: This tag should containg the nonce signature received from Apple wallet Allowable Values: 4000

request_fields.name: LeafCertificate
request_fields.description: This tag should containg the certificate received from Apple wallet Allowable Values: 4000

request_fields.name: RequiredApplePaySpecificEncryption
request_fields.description: RequiredApplePaySpecificEncryption valid value : 1/0 if WalletApplication =03 Allowable Values: 1

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: ProxyNumber
children.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

children.name: CardInfo
children.description: Mandatory for WalletApplication =01 and 02. For walletapplication =03 Card info will not be delivered.

children.name: TAV
children.description: Digital signature calculated over a concatenated string of the included field values separated by a | delimiter, in the same order as specified in the IncludedFieldsInOrder field.
